title: Chicago has nothing on me.
text: Chicago has nothing on me.. Lately, I’ve accepted the challenge of making Chicago style deep dish pizza (Pandemic challenge). I have the method and recipe down (my son schooled me based on his experience working at a pizza place last summer), my only issue is what kind of pan to use that will give me the crust that I prefer.  I have used everything from glass pie pans to cast iron skillets. Both options get the job done, but I still wanted to try a traditional, deep dish pizza pan. So, when offered this one for an honest review, I couldn’t resist. It arrived quickly and was in great shape. It is stainless steel, large, huge even. It is big enough to make a personal pan pizza (thin crust), a deep dish one, or brownies. It is a nice size for my family of 4. I was surprised about how thin the pan was. It is super lightweight. It is thinner and lighter than some of my other stainless steel pans. It does distribute the heat and cooks evenly. I guess I just expected more. And finally, caring for this pan is pretty simple. It is dishwasher safe, but I don’t usually clean or place pans in my dishwasher. I hand wash them. This pan, while huge can be stored with your other pans. In conclusion, I think this pan is a nice option, I just think it could be a little thicker.
